facts.value: Official high school transcripts are required if you have fewer than 24 transferable semester hours of college credit after high school, are applying to a program that specifically requires a high school transcript, or have earned an associate degree (or higher) but with fewer than 24 transferable semester credits post-high school.

Transcripts must reflect all four years of coursework and include the graduation date. They must be sent directly from the high school through a secure electronic service, by mail, or via email from a school official. Hand-delivered official high school transcripts are accepted only if in a sealed envelope. Faxed high school transcripts are not accepted.

For GED, order the official GED transcript online to be sent directly to ASU. ASU requires a battery average score of 170 or higher for tests taken after 2013, and also accepts HiSet, TASC, California High School Proficiency Examination, and College Credit Pathway, with some limitations.
ACT or SAT scores are not required for admission but may be used in place of a high school GPA if necessary.
Have your scores sent to ASU directly from ACT or College Board. Request AP, IB, or CLEP exam scores to be sent directly to ASU.
